meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, DBIE, via the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub's data service
meta.revisionPolicy: Each round's forecasts are final as published; later rounds are new forecasts, never revisions.
meta.coverage: Professional forecasters' quarter-by-quarter forecasts: GDP and its parts, industry, exports and imports, the rupee, oil, the repo rate
meta.note: Survey rounds dated by month: the RBI's tables give round numbers only; rounds are two months apart, round 61 = November 2019 (each round's date is checked against its first forecast quarter). Rounds 64, 71, 75, 78, 84, 86, 94, 100 are missing: the service's export repeats round 101's tables in their place; they are left empty, never filled. Each series follows one target quarter through the rounds that forecast it.
